desc: ntroducing the Socket Mount M-LOK Sling Loop attachment point, from Reptilia. Driven by the request of a military end user group, for an anti-snag, low profile, quiet M-LOK attachment. The Socket mount is machined from a single piece of billet 7075-T6 aluminum and offers a universal connection point. This socket is finished with MIL-STD Type III, Class 2, hard anodize coating.
